HAMILTON NEIL STUART GOOLD-VERSCHOYLE.

b. Dublin 19.12.04.

First applied for passport, producing authorisation from his father of The Manor House Dunkineely, Donegal and 3, St Mary's Rd (H.F.S. Goold-Verschoyle B.L.) Dublin.

Granted No. 13365 on 25.3.24. for purpose of travel to France. Vouched for by C.H. Robinson, B.L. 17B Florence Rd Ealing.

Description: Height 5'9"
eyes: grey green
hair brown.

12.3.26. Applied from 24, Paultons Sq. Chelsea for renewal for two years for purpose of travelling to Germany. Renewed to 26.3.28. Vouched for by H.H. Miller, M.D. 21, St Mary Abbots Terrace, W.14.

21.7.28. Applied for renewal for 5 periods: renewed to 26.3.33. vouched for by Stanton Coit, Minister Ethical Church, Queens Rd, W.2.

2.10.30. Left for Russia.

10.11.32. Telephoned from Moscow to SCR 1 M Montague St Smith London W.C. asking addressee to make his application for secretaryship, saying addressee knew his qualifications.

?11.8.32. Arrived London from Leningrad with Free State passp.

3.1.33. Arrived Harwich from Hook in possession of Free State Passport No. A.11399 in which he is stated to be a student. (Note his British passport is not due to expire until 26.3.33. and he had been in Moscow for three years, being occupied according to his own statement as a translator).

1.3.33. Wrote to Andrew Rothstein about a Russian student friend, from "Bryn" Pensby Rd, Heswall, Cheshire: gave also his Donegal addr. and said he would not be in London for some time.

24.10.33. Irish Free State Commissioner gave name to Passport Office in a list supplied of persons from whom it was recommended passport facilities should be withheld in view of their close association with Communist and allied organisations.

30.5.34. Telephoned to brother in London that he could not leave Moscow.

23.6.34. Telephoned again directions for approaching income tax authorities as his father was ill: said LOYLA and he were thinking of getting jobs in Soviet Offices London so that the possibility that he could help (his brother presumably - in what not stated) was remote.
